name: bookify-v2
description: Full-stack MERN E-Commerce Platform built with TypeScript

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
